ayahs.en: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,

ayahs.ar: وَرَاَيۡتَ النَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُوۡنَ فِيۡ دِيۡنِ اللّٰهِ اَفۡوَاجًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa ra-aitan naasa yadkhuloona fee deenil laahi afwajah
ayahs.en: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,

ayahs.ar: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسۡتَغۡفِرۡهُؕؔ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ تَوَّابًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa sab bih bihamdi rabbika was taghfir, innahu kaana tawwaaba
ayahs.en: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
